constraint.text: The crew paid for the earlier return with a long sea wait. Recovery rehearsal is required. Choose the other exercise.
The extra orbit left the crew facing entry with critically low RCS propellant. A systems-warning drill is required. Choose the other exercise.

status_blocks.title: Astronaut corps divided
status_blocks.text: Your endorsement of the crew criticism still divides the corps. Armstrong and Scott enter future work with damaged confidence in you; Cunningham and Stafford's support is stronger.

status_blocks.title: Ground contingency work commissioned
status_blocks.text: The crew's confidence in you has strengthened. The critics haven't withdrawn their objections; work on docked-flight contingency procedures is under way.

plans.label: Recovery + systems-warning drills.
plans.benefit: Practice the pickup call and the low-propellant warning; leave out the separate instruction-and-readback drill.

plans.label: Systems-warning + acknowledgement drills.
plans.benefit: Practice the low-propellant warning and confirmation of the entry instruction; leave out the separate pickup drill.
